entries.content: For Renovate `vulnerabilityAlerts`, shared preset consumption is not enough: caller repo GitHub vulnerability alerts must be enabled. `gh api -i /repos/{owner}/{repo}/vulnerability-alerts` returns HTTP 204 when enabled and 404 with `Vulnerability alerts are disabled.` when not. Treat disabled alerts as a functional remediation gap, not hygiene.

For reusable security-gate docs, pair Renovate remediation timing with OSV local reproduction commands by ecosystem (`uv.lock`, `bun.lock`) and a direct-vs-transitive limitation note. This prevents callers from interpreting a strict OSV failure as a weakened gate or as a guaranteed automatic Renovate PR for every lockfile-only transitive vulnerability.
